BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to intermodal container chassis; creating a newsection; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes the impacts topublic safety occasioned by unsafe equipment in intermodal commerce onthe state's roads and highways. It is the legislature's intent toensure safe transport of intermodal cargo and fair treatment of allpersons engaged in that transport.
